BiblicalUsage: Shamefulness is the word for shame, and it appears once, in Hosea's word about the calf of Bethel. In Hosea 10:6 the calf of Beth-aven shall be carried into Assyria for a present to king Jareb, and Ephraim shall receive shame, and Israel shall be ashamed of his own counsel. One word, for the shame of an idol carried off as a present.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the shame in Hosea is exact: Israel's god was carried away as a gift, and the shame was all that was left.
